corrections.title: German health portal: Statutory insurance benefits and co-payments
corrections.quote: It is compulsory to have health insurance in Germany.
corrections.summary: Germany's federal health portal explains statutory and private health insurance. Statutory contributions depend on income, while standard benefits are shared across funds; supplementary contributions and optional benefits differ. The health card provides proof of insurance at GP appointments, and certain services require co-payments. This record does not promise universally free treatment or provide current contribution rates, co-payment amounts or individual enrolment eligibility.

corrections.title: German health portal: Choosing statutory or private health insurance
corrections.quote: It is compulsory to have health insurance in Germany.
corrections.summary: Germany's federal health portal describes statutory and private insurance. Employees' access to private insurance depends on an annually adjusted income threshold; eligible employees may instead retain statutory cover. Family co-insurance has conditions, including income limits. Switching between private and statutory cover is restricted. This record does not give a current salary threshold, premium rate, mandatory document checklist or blanket pre-employment travel-insurance requirement.
